invalid_window.why: GET /api/results/displayed/{flows,loadshape,curtailment} refuses with 422 a window whose start is after its end, instead of serving some default view under a binding the browser did not ask for (assistant assurance 06, A5.2 S3a); the tab never sends one, so a caller sees it only for a malformed request.

source_not_offered.why: GET /api/results/displayed/{flows,loadshape,curtailment} refuses with 422 a `?source=` instead of ignoring it, since these views serve the solved network and their binding has no source key (assistant assurance 06, A5.2 S3a, GK S3 condition 2); the tab never sends one, so a caller sees it only for a malformed request.
